read-auto-brightness: Open Settings, open Display and brightness, and read the current auto-brightness switch state. Do not change any setting. No voice.
read-android-version: Open Settings, open About device, and read the Android version. Do not confuse Android version with ColorOS version or build number. Do not change any setting. No voice.
calculate-expression: Open Calculator and calculate (128 + 256) × 3 ÷ 4. Read the final displayed result. Use the calculator UI for the calculation; do not answer from mental arithmetic. No voice.
read-world-clock: Open Clock, open World clock, and read the currently visible city names and their displayed times. Do not add or remove cities or change alarms. No voice.
locate-calendar-date: Open Calendar, navigate to November 15, 2026, and read the selected date and its weekday from the calendar UI. Do not create, edit, or delete events. No voice.
